scenario.note: Short-time working in year 2 is required to be at least three times that in year 1.
The number of workers made redundant in year 1 is at most 1.5 times the number in year 2.
Short-time working is limited such that semi-skilled workers account for at most 5% of total short-time workers across all skill levels.
The share of semi-skilled workers on short-time working is capped at 5% of the total semi-skilled workforce.
